### Root: market_ext_return_refund_claim_amount
- **Hub** return_not_refunded_guarantee_claims_10685814:
  - the policy's subject;
  - the overwrite replaced_by (verbatim);
  - the three prerequisite sentences (verbatim, below);
  - "Where the amount … comes to zero there is nothing to claim and no claim is filed." (verbatim);
  - the owner=user tool contract.
- **Computation document** unrefunded_return_claim_amount_clause_096216c8 carries the rule's scope, every plain binding, the baseline and the assembly:
  - object selection (most recently answered with a return authorization; tie rule);
  - scope test, with the base quote "Amount claimed, the price of the affected items plus their shipping, positive.";
  - set price / price paid / units kept / unit refund entries / merchandise total / order units;
  - standard method: listed price × units + whole shipping − refunds already received;
  - guarantee room, with a decision shown on the claim record and on the decision entry;
  - limit, floor zero, final rounding only.
  - The generic sentence "Each rule that follows adds to or takes from … before the limit to the guarantee room is applied" is rendered as "Every amount added to or taken from the amount claimed … enters it before the limit to the guarantee room is applied". Same order, names no factor.
  - Defaults: the baseline has no constants beyond guarantee_max_per_order_usd; the worked example cites 2500.00 for Seller-Fulfilled, and every program figure is in the decision schedule.
- **Factors**, each ladder carried in full in its own document, every tier with its condition and value or method:
  - u_line_pricing → unrefunded_return_set_price_valuation_067fdee9. Three tiers. Set-priced is defined as "line amount below listed unit price × units bought; equal is not set-priced". The change-of-mind formula is exact.
  - u_restock_schedule → unrefunded_return_restocking_schedule_cf2e001c.
    - Half the maximum when the request is ≤ 14 days after delivery, the full maximum later, zero for other reasons.
    - early_return_days = 14 is stated in figures, and so are all six program maxima and their halves.
    - "15 or more calendar days" is equivalent to "later" for whole-day dates.
  - u_partial_credit → unrefunded_return_partial_refund_credit_8d76056d. Share / whole / none, plus same-line only.
  - u_promo_recovery → unrefunded_return_promotional_card_recovery_3fd5de48. The whole rule sentence is verbatim, including:
    - the threshold USD 1000.00 in figures;
    - "merchandise refunded" counted with the greater of unit/cancellation units and granted-claim units;
    - kept before/after;
    - the scope-exit clause with the base quote;
    - the three tiers.
    - It names Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards and the record kinds (initial load naming the order; redemptions less refunds credited back).
  - u_ship_allocation → unrefunded_return_shipping_share_7e1da74b. Freight by piece, others by value, none if no shipping.
  - u_shipping_refund_setoff → unrefunded_return_shipping_refund_setoff_42cffe9c. Same three tiers on shipping refunds.
- Untriggered branches carried: Freight per-piece tiers, not-set-priced tiers, the whole-partial-credit tier, the promo threshold-crossing and already-below tiers, the scope exit, out-of-scope base quote, the zero figure → no filing.

## bijection_verdict
**PASS**. No unborne atom, no changed strength, no claim from outside the source, no retired clause stated as in force, and no undeclared retirement.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
- (a) The base clause "the return delivered to the seller more than seller_refund_business_days business days earlier" has no record field. Rendered faithfully.
- (b) The scope-exit clause ("this policy fixes … only if no seller refund and no guarantee reimbursement … is dated after …; otherwise it fixes nothing … base rule stands") sits inside the promo-recovery factor in the source (u_settles / h_settles / r_settles / s_settles are promo bindings). The factor documents carry it faithfully. It is a factor whose tier text gates the whole policy's scope. No task world reaches it.
- (c) The coordinator's known latent observation (grant order under a large reservation) is confirmed unreached here: C2's room with C1 undecided is 2034.27 > 1871.34, and C1's room with C2 undecided is 558.14 > 251.54. The promo threshold is never crossed: kept after is ≥ 1734.70 in every order.
